system.description:
ELF

An immortal life gives the soul time to become exceptionally certain of the shape it is meant to hold.
You gain a +1-racial bonus to saving throws against possession, Soul Drain and effects with the Soul trait.
If you are at least 100 years old, you also gain a +2-racial bonus to Recall Knowledge checks concerning religious, spiritual or historical events that occurred during your lifetime, provided you could reasonably have encountered accounts of those events.

Prerequisites Level 5

Works automatically: +1 racial to saves is pre-ticked against Soul-trait and possession effects and offered against Soul Drain; the +2 to Recall Knowledge about your own lifetime is offered.
